items.question: I get blocked on /admin — what checks AdminGuard?
items.answer: The guard reads role information from localStorage set at login (`userRoleName`, `roleId`, etc.). If your account is not an admin role on the backend, routes will redirect or error.

items.question: Where is the QR type admin UI?
items.answer: Routes under admin `qr-codes`: `types`, `types/create`, `types/edit/:id` mapping to `QRTypeListComponent` and `QRTypeFormComponent`.

items.question: Why do icon previews 404?
items.answer: URLs are built as `{baseApiUrl}/content/...`. Ensure the API serves static content at that path or adjust environment base URL and deployment nginx/IIS rules.

items.question: How does admin differ from the QR owner list?
items.answer: Owner list at `/qr-codes` is for the logged-in tenant. Admin modules are for operators managing multiple tenants or templates — same APIs may apply with different authorization.
